ideas.title: Bun Starts a Package Binary but the Command Is Not Found in `node_modules/.bin`
ideas.description: Why a Bun-installed CLI fails to launch from a package binary and how to expose the executable correctly.
ideas.angle: Explain how Bun installs package executables, how the `bin` field maps to a launcher, and why a wrong or missing path leaves no usable command in `node_modules/.bin`. Cover the packaging rules, the generated wrapper, and the exact `package.json` structure that makes the binary discoverable.

drafted.title: Docker Compose Cannot Resolve a Service Name Because the Container Is on the Wrong Network
drafted.description: Why one Compose service cannot reach another by name and how network membership controls DNS resolution.
drafted.angle: Explain the built-in DNS behavior in Docker Compose and why service-name lookup fails when containers are attached to different networks or when the target service is only on an external network. Cover the name-resolution rules, the effect of custom networks and aliases, and the configuration that makes service-to-service traffic work reliably.
